faqs.question: How does Multi-Language Translated Chat work between Buyers, Sellers, and Support Agents?
faqs.answer: Every message sent in 1-on-1 or Support Dispatch chat is automatically detected and translated into each participant’s preferred language (English, Hindi, Japanese, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Arabic) via Nexconn TranslateModule & our backend translation engine.

faqs.question: What are the SLA response times in the Human Agent Dispatch Center?
faqs.answer: Urgent escalations target ~2–4 hours (with live instant dispatch), High priority ~8–12 hours, Medium ~24 hours, and Low ~48 hours. Live escalated chats appear immediately in the Support Dispatch Center.

faqs.question: Are voice notes, webcam captures, and chat files persisted safely in the cloud?
faqs.answer: Yes! Voice recordings, live webcam captures, and order inspection files are uploaded to ConvoCart Encrypted Cloud Storage and tickets/messages sync to ConvoCart Cloud Sync.

faqs.question: Can I make live Voice or Video Calls with verified sellers and support specialists?
faqs.answer: Yes. Click the Phone or Video button inside any 1-on-1 conversation to launch a live Nexconn Call SDK (@nexconn/call v26.2.1) session with real WebRTC camera & microphone controls.

faqs.question: Can I edit or recall a message after sending it in chat?
faqs.answer: Yes! Hover over any message you sent to Edit the text (auto-retranslated) or Recall/Delete it immediately for everyone in the conversation.

faqs.question: How do international orders handle customs duties and returns?
faqs.answer: Global vendors like Ubuy Global Express pre-clear customs via DHL Express so there are zero surprise import fees, backed by ConvoCart 14–30 day hub returns.

kbArticles.title: Getting Started: 1-on-1 Translated Buyer–Seller Chat & Live Dispatch
kbArticles.summary: Learn how ConvoCart connects buyers, global vendors, and multilingual human support agents in real time using Nexconn Chat SDK & Cloud Sync.
kbArticles.content:
1. Open any product or order and click "Chat with Seller" to launch a 1-on-1 encrypted conversation.
2. Choose your preferred language from the composer globe menu (EN, HI, JA, ES, FR, DE, ZH, AR).
3. AI Concierge answers instant product & policy questions grounded in vendor catalog data.
4. Need a human specialist? Click "Escalate to Human" — a ticket is synced to ConvoCart Cloud Sync and dispatched in the Human Agent Dispatch Center.
kbArticles.author: ConvoCart Support Team

kbArticles.title: Using Voice Notes, Live Webcam Proof & @nexconn/call Video Walkthroughs
kbArticles.summary: Share crystal-clear voice notes, snap live webcam unboxing/defect photos, or start a live WebRTC video inspection call.
kbArticles.content:
• Click the Microphone icon in chat to record a real-time voice message with a live 20-bar frequency waveform uploaded to Encrypted Cloud Storage.
• Click the Camera icon to capture a photo directly from your webcam for instant fit or serial-number verification.
• Click Phone or Video Call in the chat header to initiate a @nexconn/call WebRTC session.
kbArticles.author: ConvoCart Engineering

kbArticles.title: Understanding ConvoCart SLA Priorities & Refund Protection
kbArticles.summary: Clear response guarantees (Urgent ~2–4h, High ~8–12h, Medium ~24h, Low ~48h) and buyer escrow policies.
kbArticles.content: Every escalated ticket is stamped with an SLA deadline and mirrored to ConvoCart Cloud Sync. Refunds via Razorpay Test/Live Gateway are processed automatically once approved in the Support Dispatch Center.
